_comment: Parameters for the draft committee decisions. Every value here is a proposal for the committee; nothing is signed. Times are unix seconds (UTC).
nonce_note: Provisional. The registry only accepts nonce == version + 1, so nonces must be renumbered against the live registry version at signing time; renumbering changes the digest.
effective_at_note: 0 = as soon as the registry's CERT_NOTICE has passed after relay (effectiveFrom = max(effectiveAt, block.timestamp + CERT_NOTICE)).
expiry_note: Must satisfy effectiveFrom < expiry <= effectiveFrom + 366 days. Relaying before 2026-12-31 with a 7-day notice keeps this valid.
